operators.name: Zhuang Fangyi
operators.quote: Endmin, before I officially come on board, I'd like to say a few words. As Viceroy, I am experienced in administrative duties. However ... here in Endfield, I wish to serve as a regular Tianshi and focus on research.
operators.summary: **Zhuang Fangyi** is a 6★ Electric Striker Operator from the Hongshan Academy of Sciences in *Arknights: Endfield*. She is an Arts Unit user who can deal continuous and massive **Electric DMG**. Her battle skills can create **Sunderblades** that unleash Thunder Strikes on the enemy. Her ultimate also greatly enhances her combat capabilities.

potentials.desc: During the **Empyrean of Truth** transformation, DMG Dealt by Zhuang Fangyi ignores **15** of the enemy's **Electric Resistance**.

skills.name: Jolting Arts
skills.desc:
**BASIC ATTACK:**
An attack with up to 5 sequences that deals **Electric DMG**. As the controlled operator, Final Strike also deals **18** Stagger.
**DIVE ATTACK:**
Basic attack performed in mid-air becomes a dive attack that deals **Electric DMG** to nearby enemies.
**FINISHER:**
Basic attack performed near a Staggered enemy becomes a finisher that deals massive **Electric DMG** and recovers some SP.

skills.name: Mantra of Sundering
skills.desc:
**SKILL DESCRIPTION:** Consumes the target's Electrification to increase the DMG multiplier of this battle skill and create [Status Level of Electrification consumed **+1**] **Sunderblades**. If the battlefield has fewer than 3 **Sunderblades**, Mantra of Sundering can still create 1 **Sunderblade**, even if it does not consume any target's Electrification.
Zhuang Fangyi then channels all **Sunderblades** nearby to successively unleash Thunder Strikes on the target, dealing **Electric DMG** and giving bonus Ultimate Energy, with the final Thunder Strike dealing 6 times the DMG.
**A single battle skill casting can only create a max of 3 Sunderblades.**

**SKILL DESCRIPTION:** Zhuang Fangyi creates a Xiranblitz Array that attacks the enemy and deals **Electric DMG**. If the Array hits an enemy that has Electric Infliction stack(s), then it will consume the said Electric Infliction stack(s), forcibly apply Electrification, and give Ultimate Energy based on the number of stacks consumed.
If Electrification is forcibly applied to an enemy that already has Electrification, then apply Status Level +1 to the enemy's Electrification.

Zhuang Fangyi's basic attacks are enhanced and her actions are harder to interrupt;

Combo skill **Breath of Transformation** gains a higher DMG multiplier, cooldown becomes 4 times faster, and effects are applied to enemies within a small area.
The first casting of the battle skill **Mantra of Sundering** does not consume SP nor Electrification, and if a target is available, the battle skill is guaranteed to create 3 **Sunderblades** even if the target has no Electrification.

sets.name: Aburrey's Legacy
sets.effect:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's Skill DMG +24%.
When the wearer casts a battle skill, combo skill, or ultimate, the wearer gains ATK +5% for 15s. The buff from each of the three skill types is unique and does not stack with itself.

sets.name: AIC Fieldwork
sets.effect: 3-piece set effect: Wearer gain DMG Dealt +20% for all types of DMG, +10% DMG Reduction against all types of DMG, and Ultimate Gain Efficiency +10%.

sets.name: AIC Heavy
sets.effect:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's HP +500.
After the wearer defeats an enemy, the wearer restores 100 HP. Effect trigger cooldown: 5s.

sets.name: AIC Light
sets.effect:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's HP +500.
After the wearer defeats an enemy, the wearer gains ATK +20 for 5s.

sets.name: Armored MSGR
sets.effect:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's Strength +50.
When the wearer's HP is below 50%, the wearer gains 30% DMG Reduction against all types of DMG.
sets.icon: Gift of the Wilds 2 manufacturer icon.png

sets.name: Æthertech
sets.effect:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's ATK +8%.
After the wearer applies Vulnerability, the wearer gains Physical DMG +8% for 15s. This effect can reach 4 stacks. If the target already has 4 stack(s) of Vulnerability, the wearer gains an additional Physical DMG +16% for 10s. This effect cannot stack.

sets.name: Basic
sets.effect: No Set Effects

sets.name: Bonekrusha
sets.effect:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's ATK +15%.
When the wearer casts a combo skill, the wearer gains 1 stack of Bonekrushing Smash that grants the wearer's next battle skill DMG Dealt +30%. Bonekrushing Smash can stack 2 time(s).
sets.icon: Gift of the Wilds 3 manufacturer icon.png

sets.name: Catastrophe
sets.effect:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's Ultimate Gain Efficiency +20%.
The wearer casts a battle skill, the action returns 50 SP. This effect only triggers 1 time per battle.

sets.name: Deep Rampart
sets.effect:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's Arts DMG Dealt +16%.
When the wearer applies Nature Burst or Cryo Burst, the wearer gains Arts Intensity +16 for 20s. Max stacks for this effect: 3. Duration of each stack is counted separately. Effect only triggers once every 0.1s.

sets.name: Eternal Xiranite
sets.effect:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's HP +1000.
After the wearer applies Amp, Protected, Susceptibility, or Weakened, other teammates gain DMG Dealt +16% for 15s. This effect cannot stack.

sets.name: Frontiers
sets.effect:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's Combo Skill Cooldown Reduction +15%.
After the wearer's skill recovers SP, the team gains DMG +16% for 15s. This effect cannot stack.

sets.name: Grizzled Edge
sets.effect:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's ATK +8%.
When the wearer applies Crush or Breach, the wearer gains Physical DMG Dealt +[6% × Max number of Vulnerability stacks consumed from one enemy] for 20s. If the target already has Physical Susceptibility, is Staggered, or has attached Originium Crystals, increase the aforementioned buff to 1.5 times. This buff cannot stack.

sets.name: Hot Work
sets.effect:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's Arts Intensity +30.
After the wearer applies Combustion, the wearer gains Heat DMG +50% for 10s. After the wearer applies Corrosion, the wearer gains Nature DMG +50% for 10s. The aforementioned effects cannot stack.

sets.name: LYNX
sets.effect:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's HP Treatment Efficiency +20%.
After the wearer gives HP treatment to an allied target, that target also gains 15% DMG Reduction against all types of DMG for 10s. If the said treatment exceeds the target's Max HP, the target gains 30% DMG Reduction against all types of DMG. The aforementioned effects cannot stack.

sets.name: MI Security
sets.effect:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's Critical Rate +5%.
After the wearer scores a critical hit, the wearer gains ATK +5% for 5s. This effect can reach 5 stacks. At max stacks, grant an additional Critical Rate +5%. This effect cannot stack.

sets.name: Miner α
sets.effect: No Set Effects

sets.name: Miner β
sets.effect: No Set Effects

sets.name: Miner γ
sets.effect: No Set Effects

sets.name: Mordvolt Insulation
sets.effect:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's Intellect +50.
When the wearer's HP is above 80%, Arts DMG +20%.

sets.name: Mordvolt Resistant
sets.effect:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's Will +50.
When the wearer's HP is below 50%, Treatment Effect +30%.

sets.name: Pulser Labs
sets.effect:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's Arts Intensity +30.
After the wearer applies Electrification, the wearer gains Electric DMG +50% for 10s. After the wearer applies Solidification, the wearer gains Cryo DMG +50% for 10s. The aforementioned effects cannot stack.

sets.name: Qingbo
sets.effect:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's Combo Skill Cooldown Reduction +15%.
When the wearer casts a combo skill, the wearer gains Skill DMG Dealt +20% (for every skill) for 15s. This effect can reach 2 stacks. Duration of each stack is counted separately.
sets.icon: Gift of the Wilds 3 manufacturer icon.png

sets.name: Redeemer
sets.effect: No Set Effects

sets.name: Rift Trekker
sets.effect: No Set Effects

sets.name: Roving MSGR
sets.effect:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's Agility +50.
When the wearer's HP is above 80%, Physical DMG +20%.
sets.icon: Gift of the Wilds 1 manufacturer icon.png

sets.name: Swordmancer
sets.effect:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's Stagger Efficiency Bonus +20%.
After the wearer applies a Physical Status, the wearer also performs 1 hit that deals 250% ATK of Physical DMG and [10 Stagger]. Effect trigger cooldown: 15s.

sets.name: Tide Surge
sets.effect:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's Skill DMG Dealt +20%.
After the wearer applies 2 or more stacks of Arts Infliction on the enemy, the wearer gains Arts DMG Dealt +35% for 15s. This effect cannot stack.

sets.name: Type 50 Yinglung
sets.effect:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's ATK +15%.
When any operator in the team casts a battle skill, the wearer gains 1 stack of Yinglung's Edge that gives DMG +20% to the wearer's next combo skill. Yinglung's Edge can stack 3 time(s).

sets.name: Xiranflow
sets.effect:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's ATK +10%.
Whenever the wearer consumes Electrification or Corrosion, the wearer gains a number of buff stacks equal to the Status Level of the Arts Reaction consumed, with each buff stack giving Electric DMG Dealt and Nature DMG Dealt +15% for 25s. The number of buff stacks maxes out at 3 stacks. Duration of each stack is counted separately.

Bonekrusher Infiltrator is a Common enemy in Arknights: Endfield.

keys: ホ ーンクラッシャーの潜入者

enemies.name: Bonekrusher Siegeknuckles

names.ja: ボーンクラッシャーの攻城者

Bonekrusher Siegeknuckles is an Elite enemy in Arknights: Endfield.

Breaking Gust is an Elite enemy in Arknights: Endfield.

Brutal Pincerbeast is a Common enemy in Arknights: Endfield.

enemies.name: Cloud Obliterator
enemies.summary:
Cloud Obliterator is an Elite enemy in Arknights: Endfield.
Enemy descriptionA criminal equipped with heavy weaponry. Obliteration is no small feat. Only the strongest smashers armed with quadruple rocket launchers can achieve the title of Cloud Obliterator.

enemies.name: Cloud Stalker
enemies.summary:
Cloud Stalker is an Advanced enemy in Arknights: Endfield.

enemies.name: Effigy

Effigy is an Elite enemy in Arknights: Endfield.

enemies.name: Elite Ambusher

enemies.name: Elite Executioner

Elite Executioner is an Elite enemy in Arknights: Endfield.
Enemy descriptionAn elite Landbreaker brute enhanced by fumes known as hazefyre. This particular LB is a towering giant armed with a great axe. Such elites are usually seen leading Bonekrusher raiding mobs.

enemies.name: Elite Raider
enemies.summary:
Elite Raider is a Common enemy in Arknights: Endfield.
Enemy descriptionAn elite Landbreaker melee combatant enhanced by fumes known as hazefyre. This particular LB has better gear, strength, and battle skills.

enemies.name: Elite Ripptusk
enemies.summary:
Elite Ripptusk is a Common enemy in Arknights: Endfield.
Enemy descriptionAn elite Landbreaker warbeast enhanced by fumes known as hazefyre. This particular ripptusk is more ferocious and cunning, and attacks with less predictable moves.

enemies.name: Ereignis
enemies.summary:
Ereignis is a Boss enemy in Arknights: Endfield.
Enemy descriptionWhat is the meaning of progress? What constitutes meaning? What is the nature of life?

enemies.name: Falsewings

Falsewings is a Common enemy in Arknights: Endfield.

Falsewings α is a Common enemy in Arknights: Endfield.
Enemy descriptionThe "Psuthopteron Anavon" (archive ID: ARA07Cα) is an energized variant of the ARA07C. Most observers regard color as the only differentiating feature between the Anavon and the basic variants.

enemies.name: Firemist Originium Slug

enemies.name: Fortune's Stash
enemies.summary:
Fortune's Stash is a Common enemy in Arknights: Endfield.
Enemy descriptionAn apparition enlightened by Si. A fortune saved is generosity ensured. With wealth in hand is light secured.

enemies.name: Glaring Rakerbeast
enemies.summary:
Glaring Rakerbeast is an Elite enemy in Arknights: Endfield.
Enemy descriptionA rakerbeast variant featuring a different colored coat, shorter lifespan, but greater strength. Its eyes seem to glow like liquid fire.

Grove Archer is a Common enemy in Arknights: Endfield.

Quillbeast is an Advanced enemy in Arknights: Endfield.

Quillbeast Blightshade is an Advanced enemy in Arknights: Endfield.

Rakerbeast Blightshade is an Elite enemy in Arknights: Endfield.

Scroll of Tactics is a Common enemy in Arknights: Endfield.

enemies.name: Shroomkrusher Sporeknuckles

Shroomkrusher Sporeknuckles is an Elite enemy in Arknights: Endfield.

Spotted Rakerbeast is an Elite enemy in Arknights: Endfield.

Sting α is a Common enemy in Arknights: Endfield.
Enemy descriptionThe "Kentron Anavon" (archive ID: ARL121α) is an energized variant of ARL121. The entity's higher energy density gives it greater firepower. The energy efficiency of its firing mechanism remains low.

Sweeping Wind is a Common enemy in Arknights: Endfield.

Tidewalker δ is an Elite enemy in Arknights: Endfield.

Tunneling Nidwyrm is an Advanced enemy in Arknights: Endfield.

Tuskbeast Blightshade is a Common enemy in Arknights: Endfield.
Enemy descriptionA manifestation of residual Æther energy that projects the outward form of a tuskbeast. Although this is but a "lingering shadow", its sharp fangs are still capable of tearing through armor and protective gear.
